mapper.select: select u.*, s.space_type from pcd_uploads_session_table u left join pcd_space_table s on s.space_id = u.uploads_space_id where u.uploads_id=#{uploads_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler};
mapper.insert: insert into pcd_uploads_session_table (uploads_id, uploads_user_id, uploads_total_chunks, uploads_starting_time, uploads_endding_time, uploads_file_size, uploads_file_checksum, uploads_chunks_max_size, uploads_file_name, uploads_file_type, uploads_node_id, uploads_status, uploads_space_id) values(#{uploads_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{user_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{total_chunks}, #{starting_time}, #{endding_time}, #{file_size}, #{file_checksum}, #{chunks_max_size}, #{file_name}, #{file_type}, #{node_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{space_id,typeHandler=org.project.util.UUIDBinaryTypeHandler});
